title: [UI][Sorting] Products are sorted by name A to Z by default
precondition: Standard user has just logged in and is on the Products page; no sort option has been chosen.

steps.action: Read the selected value of the sort dropdown
Read the product names from top to bottom
steps.expected: Order is: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light, Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket, Sauce Labs Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)

gherkin:
Given I have just logged in as a standard user
Then the sort dropdown shows "Name (A to Z)"
And the six products are listed alphabetically by name
